translations.web: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
translations.bsb: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
translations.kjv: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
translations.asv: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; Yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
